title: Band personnel and saxophonist Purnell
summary: Howard Davis leaves for California; Richards praises a saxophonist Parnell and others used in his band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: They had night parties. Especially during the rush week. We used to be busy every night. And, uh, we had the same group with Albert French, Howard Davis, Alvin Alcon, and, uh, Sidney Montaguey on the drums. And very similar, we used a bass, but that was usually a five-piece band. We had a little, a good five-piece band. We could play any kind of music that people wanted. If they wanted Dixieland, we could play that. And, uh, if they wanted any kind of music, we could play it. Now, Al- Howard Davis left town, and he went to California. I met him out there two years ago. Uh-huh. And, uh, we started using, uh, Parnell. We were lucky to get him. Oh, yeah. Between his six bells. Alton. Is it, uh, Alton Parnell is...
He's a piano player. No, not here. He's a brother.
